description: This Java source file defines the class RandomNumberProviderService, which extends ComplicationProviderService. It provides data for a wearable device complication, generating random numbers and supplying different data types like ranged values, short text, and long text, with tap actions to trigger updates.

classes.name: RandomNumberProviderService
classes.description: A service providing random number data for wearable complications, supporting multiple data types and tap actions.

methods.name: onComplicationActivated
methods.description: Initial setup when a complication is activated, logs activation.

methods.name: onComplicationUpdate
methods.description: Generates a random number, constructs appropriate complication data based on data type, and sends the data to update the complication display. Also sets up tap actions to trigger updates.

methods.name: onComplicationDeactivated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a complication is deactivated, logs deactivation.
